LOADING_SCREEN.SettingEnabledHint: Display the custom loading screen when switching scenes.

LOADING_SCREEN.SettingSceneNameSourceHint: Choose whether players see the hidden scene name or the navigation name while loading.
LOADING_SCREEN.SettingImageFolderHint: File or wildcard pattern for the loading images, used when a scene has none of its own.
LOADING_SCREEN.SettingImageRotateHint: Switch the image from a fixed interval.
LOADING_SCREEN.SettingImageIntervalHint: Duration of the image in the screen, before it changes.
LOADING_SCREEN.SettingMinDurationHint: Minimum time the loading screen will remain. 0 closes it as soon as the scene is ready.
LOADING_SCREEN.SettingFadeDurationHint: How long the loading screen fade-in and fade-out animations last.
LOADING_SCREEN.SettingShowProgressHint: Display a loading bar. It follows the real texture loading.
LOADING_SCREEN.SettingShowTipsHint: Display a text (tips, GM helps) in the bottom of the loading screen.
LOADING_SCREEN.SettingTipRotationHint: How often the text is changed.
LOADING_SCREEN.SettingSoundVolumeHint: Volume multiplier for tracks played in the loading screen.
LOADING_SCREEN.SettingBlockNotificationsHint: When enabled, info notifications are hidden while the loading screen is active.
LOADING_SCREEN.SettingRedrawSameSceneHint: Also show the screen when the current scene is drawn again, such as when changing levels or after editing the scene.
LOADING_SCREEN.SettingCustomTipsHint: Create your own tips (one tip per line). If empty, default tips will be used.
LOADING_SCREEN.SettingPreviewHint: Show the loading screen on your screen without loading a scene.
LOADING_SCREEN.PreviewHint: Only to GM vision. You can close it early.
